items.q: Louie Mitchell was a drummer and leader. ... Walter Kildaire, string bass.

ctx.x: 1919. Louie Mitchell was a drummer and leader. Dan Parrish, piano. Ferdie Allen, banjo and guitar. Walter Kildaire, string bass. Jean Brashear, trombone. Cricket Smith, trumpet. He became leader after Mitchell's bankruptcy, --
